notesStmt.note: The letter on the verso of this manuscript is dated January 27, 1888. The manuscript was therefore written sometime between that date and March 12, when the poem was published.

This is a lightly corrected and signed draft of "America," a poem first published in the New York Herald on March 12, 1888. It was reprinted in November Boughs (1888) and in the "Sands at Seventy" annex of Leaves of Grass (1891–92).

The manuscript is written on the reverse of a letter fragment from an unknown correspondent.

lg.l: Centre of equal daughters, equal sons,

All, all alike endear'd, grown, ungrown,
s young or old,

Perennial with the earth, with Freedom,
Law and Love,
A grand, sane, towering, seated Mother,
Chair'd in the adamant of Time.
